reproducibility.code:
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(os.environ['SKILL_DIR']) / 'scripts'))
from eda_io import load_table, numeric_value
from plots import histogram
frame = load_table(Path('shift_log.csv'), header=True).frame
print(sum(map(numeric_value, frame['units'])))
print(sum(map(numeric_value, frame.loc[frame['state'] == 'open', 'units'])))
histogram(frame, 'units', 'volume_histogram.png', x_unit='units')
